description: Standalone JSON Schema for every Blueprint section (BP-SCH-006). Keyed lists follow the layout table in content/layout.py. S2 SRS BP-SCH-002 makes project.defaultLanguage / project.translationLanguages the only storage location for languages, so generationPolicy carries no language fields.

project.title: project
project.description: Delivery mode, project type, target DHIS2 version constraint and languages (BP-SCH-002). Writable only by initialization and delivery-mode upgrade, both SYSTEM-authored (appendix A).

requirements.title: requirements
requirements.description: Normalized requirements referencing the original input artifacts (FR-BP-002).

domain.title: domain
domain.description: Domain entities, their attributes, lifecycles and relationships (overall SRS 9.1). Attribute sensitivity is mandatory for PII and drives data classification, sharing and fixture generation (FR-DOM-001).

organizationModel.title: organizationModel
organizationModel.description: Organisation unit hierarchy needs and references. OrganisationUnit defaults to REFERENCE (FR-COV-007).

accessModel.title: accessModel
accessModel.description: Roles, user groups and sharing intention for every managed object (FR-COV-006, FR-PG-001). Changing it is a Major change (appendix B).

architecture.title: architecture
architecture.description: Architecture decision records (ADR). Frozen with the mapping by ARCHITECTURE_GATE (BP-BR-07).

mapping.title: mapping
mapping.description: Domain element to DHIS2 expression, with rejected alternatives, risks, confidence and the decision that produced it (FR-MAP-001, overall SRS 5.4). Object definitions are compiled from here, so raw metadata JSON is not allowed (FR-BP-002).

structure.description: Composition of the mapped object: nested parts such as program stages, sections, rule lists or option sets.

registry.title: registry
registry.description: Metadata Registry: the normalized identity index and the only source of UIDs (overall SRS 5.5). Per-environment bindings are NOT part of version content (BP-REG-010.4) and therefore have no property here.

observedUid.description: The UID S2 observed for this existing object in the design reference environment. A patch may record an observation; only S2 turns it into the entry's uid, so a patch can never invent identity (BP-DRF-005.4, BP-REG-001).

pages.title: pages
pages.description: Page model (delivery mode B). Every page references Registry entries only (FR-PG-002).

apiIntents.title: apiIntents
apiIntents.description: Page-level DHIS2 API intents (overall SRS 10.2). resource is a logical name resolved by the Capability Profile; version-specific paths and UIDs are forbidden here (FR-API-001, FR-PG-002).

paramSource.description: Where a parameter value comes from: route, user input, a previous call result, or a Registry constant (overall SRS 10.2).

uiIntents.title: uiIntents
uiIntents.description: Page structure and behaviour (overall SRS 10.3). Component names should come from @dhis2/ui (FR-UII-001) and every data source must resolve to an operationKey or Registry entry (FR-UII-002).

rules.title: rules
rules.description: Validation rules, program rules, rule variables and indicators. Expressions reference objects by businessKey; the compiler substitutes the environment UID (FR-CMP-010).

fixtures.title: fixtures
fixtures.description: Synthetic demo data specifications (overall SRS 20.4). Only specifications live here; the Fixture Compiler generates values from the seed in the build context (FR-POL-006/008). Demo users carry no password (FR-COV-008).

not.description: A fixture specification must never carry a credential (FR-COV-008, FR-FE-005).

generationPolicy.title: generationPolicy
generationPolicy.description: Code prefix and naming convention, UID pool sizing, per-type environment binding rules, deletion policy and the two confidence thresholds (BP-SCH-003). Languages are excluded: project is their only storage location (BP-SCH-002).

namingConvention.description: How the stable code of a managed object is derived (FR-REG-008).

deletionPolicy.description: Deletion is never part of a default compile (FR-CMP-009).
